title: Cross-Surface Governance Spine P0 Implementation v1

offenders_addressed.description: GovernanceRuntime always returns EXECUTE for every permission check — bypasses all governance gates
offenders_addressed.fix_detail: GovernanceRuntime.should_execute_tool() now evaluates mutation tools through GovernanceEngine. Mutation-adjacent tool names (write_file, search_replace, bash, checkpoint, etc.) are classified by _is_likely_mutation_tool() and routed to evaluate_mutation_legality(). Read-only tools still EXECUTE with a decision_id. Mutation tools that GovernanceEngine blocks or requires review are SKIPped with feedback.

offenders_addressed.description: GateDecision lacks decision_id — no stable identifier for governance decisions
offenders_addressed.fix_detail: GateDecision now includes decision_id (content-light SHA256-derived identifier starting with 'gd-'), surface, authority_tier, capability_id, request_id, content_light (always true), and generated_at fields.

offenders_addressed.description: MCP server completely ungoverned — no governance engine evaluation
offenders_addressed.fix_detail: MCP server call_tool() and call_tool_sync() now block tier-4+ tools with structured refusal messages referencing cross_surface_authority_spine v1. Tier-5 tools always blocked. Both methods include content_light flag, refusal_code, and approval_required indicator. Uses tool.tier is not None instead of truthy check to handle IntEnum(0) correctly.

offenders_addressed.description: MCP mutation gate is advisory string check, not enforced block
offenders_addressed.fix_detail: MCP mutation gate is now an enforced block (not advisory). The check uses explicit tier comparison, returns 'blocked' status with refusal_code, and includes canonical authority spine reference in the message. The authorization_receipt parameter alone does not bypass the block.

MCP authentication remains a P1 item. Per-user authorization (MCPPerUserAuthorization) model exists but is not enforced. This P0 slice focuses on making the mutation gate real; full MCP auth requires descriptor integrity, roots enforcement, and content-light scanning per the authority spine.

Added delegation_allowed_by_governance() function that blocks all A2A delegation with reference to cross_surface_authority_spine v1. build_delegation_receipt() now calls the governance check and returns refused verdict when blocked.
ReceiptDecision now includes surface, authority_tier, capability_id, approval_receipt_id, and content_light_classification fields. All are optional for backward compatibility.
ToolDecision now includes decision_id, surface, and authority_tier fields. Default surface='agent_loop', authority_tier='local_mutation'.

offenders_intentionally_deferred.reason: MCP per-user authorization enforcement requires descriptor integrity, roots enforcement, and content-light scanning first per authority spine. P1 item.

offenders_intentionally_deferred.reason: P1 item — requires MCP/ACP/A2A/WebSocket surface owners to adopt common envelope.

telemetry_redaction_implications: All new fields are content-light: decision_id is SHA256-derived, content_light is always true on GateDecision, ReceiptDecision content_light_classification is optional string metadata. No raw tokens, secrets, or content introduced into telemetry surfaces.
frontend_implications: Cockpit can now reference decision_id for 'why blocked' governance explainer. Requires P1 integration.
cli_implications: CLI/scripts not directly affected by this P0 slice. GovernanceRuntime integration with CLI requires P1 CLI taxonomy unification.
mcp_implications: MCP mutation tools now blocked server-side (not advisory). Tier-0 to Tier-3 read-only/analysis/validation tools remain functional. MCP call_tool_sync added for testing.
acp_implications: ACP not directly affected by this P0 slice. ACP integration with governance spine requires P1 IDE sidecar convergence.
a2a_implications: All A2A delegation now blocked with governance refusal. delegation_allowed_by_governance() returns False for all callers. This aligns with authority spine directive: A2A must not operate without Agent Card attestation and trust tier enforcement.
ssh_implications: SSH not affected — still absent per authority spine. This P0 slice reinforces the block.
hosted_implications: Hosted mode not affected — still design phase per authority spine. This P0 slice establishes the governance foundation hosted mode will build on.
github_trust_spine_implications: GovernanceRuntime now evaluates mutation tools through GovernanceEngine, which checks mutation capabilities. This is the code-level enforcement the GitHub Trust Spine requires. GitHub mutation adapter must still implement trust-spine-specific checks (permission probe, rate-limit budget, etc.) per trust spine requirements.
postgres_source_of_truth_implications: No Postgres changes in this P0 slice. GateDecision and ReceiptDecision models align with the common envelope spine which will inform future Postgres operational projections.
